blocks.section: Install the baseplate using jackscrews
blocks.content: Level the pump mounting pads:

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using jackscrews
blocks.content: NOTICE: Remove all dirt from the mounting pads in order to make sure that you achieve the correct leveling. Failure to do so can result in equipment damage or decreased performance.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using jackscrews
blocks.content: Put one machinist's level lengthwise on one of  the two pads.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using jackscrews
blocks.content: Put the other level across the center of  the two pads.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using jackscrews
blocks.content: Level the pads by adjusting the four jackscrews in the corners. Make sure that the machinist's level readings are as close to zero as possible, both lengthwise and across.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using jackscrews
blocks.content: Hand-tighten the nuts for the foundation bolts.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using jackscrews
blocks.content: Check that the driver's mounting pads are level and adjust the jackscrews and the foundation bolts if necessary.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using jackscrews
blocks.content: The correct level measurement is a maximum of 0.002 in./ft (0.0167 mm/m).

blocks.content: Install the baseplate using spring mounting

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: NOTICE: The spring-mounted baseplate is designed only to support piping loads from thermal expansion. You must support the suction and discharge piping individually. Failure to do so may result in equipment damage.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: The foundation pads are not provided with the baseplate. Make sure that the foundation pads are 316 stainless-steel plates, which have a 16-20 micro-inch surface finish.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: Before you start this procedure, make sure that the foundation pads are correctly installed on the foundation/floor (see the manufacturer's instructions).

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: Put the baseplate on a support above the foundation/floor.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: Make sure that there is enough space between the baseplate and the foundation/floor in order to install the spring assemblies.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: Install the lower part of  the spring assembly:

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: Screw the lower jam nut onto the spring stud.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: Screw the lower adjusting nut onto the spring-stud, on top of  the jam nut.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: Set the lower adjusting nut to the correct height.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: The correct height depends on the required distance between the foundation/floor and the baseplate.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: Put a washer, a follower, a spring, and one more follower onto the lower adjusting nut.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: Install the spring assembly on the baseplate:

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: Insert the spring assembly into the baseplate's anchorage hole from below.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: Put a follower, a spring, another follower, and a washer onto the spring stud.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: Fasten the spring assembly with the upper adjusting nut by hand.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: Thread the upper jam nut onto the spring stud by hand.

blocks.section: Install the baseplate using spring mounting
blocks.content: Repeat steps 2 through 4 for all the spring assemblies.
